propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' when running test_matching_guard_is_accepted on Python 3.11 but not 3.12, occurring randomly on one of four matrix shards

asyncio.wait_for on Python 3.11 consumes external cancellation when its child task completes in the same event-loop turn, causing the worker to loop back to queue.get() with cancelling==1 while lifespan awaits forever
the defect is fixed by replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=...) with async with asyncio.timeout(...): await asyncio.to_thread(...) to restore correct cancellation semantics
the crash reproduces locally under host CPU/memory contention in xdist teardown with OSError during worker-channel close, indicating a load-dependent teardown race condition
original hypothesis of orphaned default-executor threads from asyncio.to_thread surviving portal teardown was falsified by root-cause analysis in the duplicate ticket
